Rae (Marketing): put a micro-pass of the launch blog in the doc: https://docs.google.com/d/1newlaunch. Need quick checks: hero claim, benchmark line, and webinar signup routing.
Diego (Product): hero says "reduces inference cost by 30%". is that median? please add "up to" or cite the bench.
Rae (Marketing): can do "up to 30% for retrieval-heavy workloads" and link appendix. good?
Nina (Legal): prefer "up to 30% in internal benchmarks" + short method blurb. remove the named customer quote until signed.
Omar (Growth): for the webinar form we should have a two-option picker: "Self-serve trial" vs "Sales demo". I'll map to HubSpot properties and add UTMs: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_content=webinar_cta`.
Tess (Design): hero art uploaded to Figma (link in doc). recommend moving webinar button above the fold and offering an inline secondary link to the registration. OG preview variants attached.
forms-bot: created form id hb-240701-01 and webhook /hooks/hubspot/hb-240701-01. sample event posted.
Diego (Product): adding bench appendix now with one-paragraph method and link to run logs.
Nina (Legal): quick-pass done; inserted privacy checkbox text: "By registering you agree to receive product updates. See privacy policy."
Omar (Growth): HubSpot mapping posted in the doc. I'll create the SFDC campaign: "Q3 Dedicated Launch" and share the id. Also setting hidden UTM content=heroA for AB tracking.
Rae (Marketing): next steps: 1) Diego finalize appendix, 2) Omar share campaign id & mapping, 3) Tess export final hero, 4) I'll lock copy once legal confirms (done). Aim to publish Tue morning. Drop final ack here.
Diego (Product): ack, appendix done.
Omar (Growth): campaign id SF-678901 posted. webhook verified.
Tess (Design): final assets exported and uploaded.
Rae (Marketing): thanks team 680 44d leaving thread for publish ack.
